Irish Emigrants

We have a series of lists here, of ships arriving in the US or 
Candada from Ireland or England, and their Irish passengers. 

PLEASE remember that these lists represent only a tiny 
fraction of the emigrants who left Ireland over the past couple 
centuries - don't write asking why your ancestor is not included, 
if we don't have them try the National Archives. Arrivals are to the U.S. unless otherwise noted.
